description: I don’t want to be anyone other than myself #dreamlife #selflove #selfpreservation
transcript: I don't want to be anyone other than myself. I prioritize self-reliance, or tend to be able to make decisions on your own, be able to just take action and move forward. I rely on myself, and I'm not scared to be alone with myself. I fear allowing the external world to take control of my boat rather than me staring at myself.
